item.title: How China's AI Labs Are Chasing Recursive Self-Improvement Without Touching Model Weights
item.description: Zhipu, DeepSeek, ModelBest, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, ByteDance and Xiaomi all show recursive self-improvement work, but each aims AI at the machinery around models, not the weights.

item.title: Tsinghua and Zhipu's HarnessPro Lets Agents Rewrite Their Own Harness, Cutting Task Costs 26%
item.description: HarnessPro, from Tsinghua, Zhipu and partners, has agents study their own runs and rewrite their harness without reference answers, raising pass rates 2 points and cutting cost per task 26.1%.

item.title: China Southern Power Grid and Huawei Sign Deeper Pact on AI, Compute and Power IoT OS Dianhong
item.description: China Southern Power Grid and Huawei signed a deeper strategic cooperation agreement on October 27 covering power-carbon-compute coordination, AI, the Dianhong power IoT OS and the industry ecosystem.

item.title: ACE Robotics and NTU S-Lab Unveil Mundo, a World Model That Builds Robot Training Scenes From Photos
item.description: Mundo turns one to 12 photos of a real place into an editable 3D scene with physics, then renders robot navigation and manipulation in it. Code and weights are due by the end of November.

item.title: Tencent Map Opens Its Agent Capabilities to Developers Through MCP, Agent Skills and Connectors
